data.name: Amorita
data.gender_notes: Amorita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'amor', meaning 'love'. In Christian tradition, Amorita symbolizes the divine love and protection of the Virgin Mary. The name Amorita carries the meaning “Little love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amorita usually hope their child will grow to embody little love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with love, compassion, and grace.
data.etymology: Amorita belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amorita total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Amorita has a profound spiritual meaning within Christianity, representing the unwavering, nurturing love of the Virgin Mary. The name Amorita can serve as a reminder of the divine love and protection that God offers to believers. Additionally, it can inspire a deeper connection to the Virgin Mary, particularly for those who seek her intercession in their lives.
